sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Stupor, alternating with restless melan-
choly. Irritable, worse least opposition ; goes into a rage*
over trifles.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Frontal headache. Eyeballs prominent.
Face flushed ; lips burn. Tongue thickly coated.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Weak, frequent pulse, with inability to lie
down. Tachycardia. [Naja.] Anxiety about chest, as
if constricted. Palpitation from least exertion. Severe
heart pain. Ready excitability of heart. Heart’s action
weak.


747

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Increased flow; polyuria; some albumen
and sugar. Enuresis in weakly children who are nerv-
ous and irritable gr. night and morning). Urine
smells of violets, burning along urethra, increase of
uric acid.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Dry, painful cough with scanty, diffi-
cult expectoration and burning in pharynx.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Psoriasis associated with adiposity (not in
developing stage). Skin dry, impoverished. Cold hands
and feet. Ecsema. Uterine fibroids. Brattmy swelling.
Swelling of glands of stony hardness. Sluggish cases.
Jaundice with pruritus. Ichthyosis, lupus.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Spongia; Calc.; Fucus;
Ly copus; Jodothyrine, the active principle isolated from
thyroid gland, a substance rich in Iodine and nitrogen,
affects metabolism, reducing weight, may produce glyco-
suria. Use cautiously in obesity, for a fatty heart may
not be able to maintain the accelerated rhythm. Milk
contains the internal secretion of the thyroid. .Thymus
gland extract (arthritis deformans ; metabolic osteoar-
thritis, 5-grain tablets 3 times daily).
